entities.summary: José Luis Damiani is a retired professional tennis player from Uruguay. He turned pro in 1977 and retired in 1983. Damiani won two ATP Tour doubles titles in his career, and reached career-high rankings of No. 32 in singles and No. 49 in doubles. He is the former captain of the Uruguay Davis Cup team. José Luis Damiani was a athletes & competitors from Montevideo (b. 1956-11-21, Montevideo). A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
